messages:
Maria (PM): quick intake — ACME wants a tiered launch signal for tenant rollouts. problem: spikes in request volume cause P95 to jump and we then see cost > forecast. want a lightweight guardrail we can ship in 2 sprints. goals/non-goals + success metrics by EOD?
Chris (Eng): +1. want to confirm scope: routing/policy + console UI + monitoring hooks? or also runtime changes (batching/kv cache)?
Maria (PM): prefer minimal runtime changes first. phase 1 = routing + per-tenant QoS config + simple fallback. runtime optimizations are phase 2. non-goal: quantization/engine kernels.
Anika (SRE): need circuit breaker + automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant. define thresholds and cool-downs. who owns rollout automation? @Chris (Eng)?
Chris (Eng): I can own infra part but need explicit acceptance criteria. also need eval set to validate quality when we fallback. @Eva (Data) can you surface recommended evals?
Eva (Data): will pull a small eval: 1) latency-sensitive prompts (50 short queries), 2) temperature-stable prompts (30), 3) hallucination-sensitive set (20). metrics: accuracy/regression delta, token savings, cache hit %. aim: <= 3% quality regression for fallback path.
Sam (Design): for Console UX, propose two places: per-tenant QoS config and global rollout controls (canary/burst policies). wireframe quick idea: toggle for "enable soft-QoS", slider for burst limit, fallback model dropdown.
Maria (PM): initial acceptance criteria suggestion:
```
- API: create/update per-tenant qos policy (JSON schema)
- Console: enable/disable per-tenant policy and override during rollout
- Automation: when P95 > X ms for > Y sec AND cost burn rate > Z%, route new requests to fallback model variant
- Observability: new dashboard with P50/P95/P99, cost per 1M tokens, %requests routed to fallback, quality regression alerts
- Safety: rollback form and audit log for policy changes
```
Chris (Eng): need concrete numbers for X/Y/Z before we can size. propose X=500ms, Y=60s, Z=30% as draft.
Anika (SRE): suggest adding error-rate threshold too (5% 5xx). also require a manual-confirm after automatic fallback for 10m before full rollback.
Eva (Data): for quality regression alerts, we should tie to eval gate: flag if regression > 2% on the eval suite in production-sampled traffic. sampling rate suggestion: 1% of traffic routed through canary pipeline.
Maria (PM): dependencies: model variants published and tagged, routing table changes, console API, alerting/metrics. timeline: 2 sprints for phase 1 if infra + console estimates fit.
Chris (Eng): blocker: need model-variant compatibility matrix from Model Onboarding team. also need an endpoint in runtime to accept "fallback:true" header.
Sam (Design): I'll sketch wires and copy for modal with rollback confirmation.
Anika (SRE): ops playbook item: add runbook steps for manual override and emergency throttle.
ci-deploy-bot: New RFC created: <https://rfc.internal/r/2026/tenant-qos-soft-fallback> by Maria (PM)
Maria (PM): thanks all — action items: @Chris produce infra spec + estimate, @Eva produce eval sets + thresholds, @Sam mockups by tomorrow noon, @Anika draft runbook. i'll consolidate into RFC and circulate for final review.
Chris (Eng): ack — will post infra PRD by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Eva (Data): will drop eval CSV and script link into the RFC.
Sam (Design): on it :spiral_calendar:
Anika (SRE): will add rollback entries to runbook and sync with oncall.
Maria (PM): if anyone has hard objections to the non-goals (no runtime kernel changes in phase1) speak now. otherwise i'll move this to RFC state.
Chris (Eng): no objections from infra side.
Anika (SRE): fine from SRE.
Maria (PM): cool — moving to RFC. thanks. :white_check_mark:
